subject: End-cycle notice and TfC fallback — AcmeCo redlines
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmeco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmeco.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed redlines to MSA + Order Form — notice & TfC

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached are AcmeCo's redlines for the MSA and Order Form focused on the end-of-term mechanics. Key asks:

- Limit auto-renew to 12-month increments and require 60-day notice prior to auto-renew.
- Stronger termination-for-convenience (TfC) for AcmeCo: ability to terminate with 90 days' notice if Redwood cannot meet committed throughput SLA for two consecutive months.
- Transition support: 45 days of escrowed handover support without additional fees.

We tracked changes in the attached doc (Acme_Redlines_MSA_Tracked.docx) and added an Order Form summary (Acme_OrderForm_Redlines.pdf). Can you confirm who on your side will own the legal review and whether Redwood is open to a short carveout around the TfC SLA trigger?

Best,
Samantha Li
Sr. Contracts Manager — AcmeCo
attachments: Acme_Redlines_MSA_Tracked.docx (docx), Acme_OrderForm_Redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmeco.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA + Order Form — notice & TfC

Samantha — thanks for the redlines and the clear summary. I opened the attachments. High level reaction:

- Auto-renew window: 60 days notice for renewal is within the realm of what we can accept operationally, but we prefer 30 days for growth customers. We can offer 60 days if AcmeCo commits to a 12-month renew cadence.
- TfC SLA-triggered termination: this is the main sticking point. We need to avoid a carveout that exposes Redwood to frequent early exits for transient performance variance.
- Transition support: 45 days is reasonable; we should detail the scope (RTO/RPO, data export formats, knowledge transfer sessions).

Looping in Markus (commercial) and Karthik (legal-matrix/AM) to weigh in with specific language and commercial concessions. Expect an internal redline from us by EOD tomorrow.

Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmeco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA + Order Form — notice & TfC

Olga / Karthik / Samantha — quick commercial take:

- We can accept the 12-month auto-renew cadence with 60 days notice only if AcmeCo signs a minimum 9-month termination notice for TfC (i.e., they can't flip the relationship in <9 months). That balances predictability.
- For TfC tied to SLA, propose a two-strike rule: TfC only available after two consecutive monthly SLA misses where monthly uptime < agreed threshold AND we've failed to remediate per the incident action plan. This protects us from one-off outages.
- As a concession, offer an extended data export bundle (no-cost exports for 45 days) and two dedicated handover sessions.

If legal can propose concrete language that implements the two-strike safeguard, I'm comfortable sharing a redline to Samantha with these commercial guardrails.

-Markus
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmeco.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA + Order Form — notice & TfC

Samantha — thanks. Attached is our suggested compromise in tracked form (I have also added a short fallback clause for accidental double-terminations). Highlights:

- Auto-renew: clean language that fixes renewal to 12 months and requires 60 days notice for non-renewal; we added a mutual early-exit exception tied to insolvency events.
- TfC SLA mechanism: "TfC for SLA" is limited to: (a) two consecutive calendar months where agreed throughput/latency SLA is missed, (b) Redwood failure to remediate within the incident remediation window defined in Section 7.3, and (c) customer provides 30 days' cure notice after remediation plan is offered.
- Transition support: 45 days of handover included; we explicitly limit to operational runbooks, two 2-hour KT sessions, and one engineer on-call for the 45-day period. Additional support billed at then-current SOW rates.

Please note: legal (Mina) suggested tightening the cure window language and clarifying what counts as an SLA "miss" (percentile vs. p95). Mina — can you review the attached and advise final wording?

Attachment: Redwood_Term_Amendment_Suggested.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Karthik (on behalf of Commercial)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmeco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 23:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines to MSA + Order Form — notice & TfC

Samantha / Karthik / Olga — legal review complete. I incorporated clarifications and replaced ambiguous SLA references with explicit metrics. Key legal edits:

- SLA trigger: define as p99 latency and 99.5% monthly availability across provisioned endpoints; specify measurement method (instrumentation source).
- Cure mechanics: 30 days' notice to the customer after remediation plan is provided; if remedied within 30 days, TfC option lapses. If not remedied, AcmeCo may exercise TfC with 90 days' termination notice.
- Liability/credits: TfC execution will not waive previously accrued service credits; post-termination refund mechanics limited to unused prepaid fees on a pro rata basis.
- Transition scope tightened to avoid open-ended obligations; included specific deliverables and handover timeline.

Samantha — if this aligns, can you confirm acceptance of the two-strike measurement + the 30-day cure step? If AcmeCo accepts, we'll send the clean MSA and Order Form with these redlines and the attached amendment.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Term_Amendment_Suggested.docx (docx)
